content: ईह् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (ईहते, ईहाञ्चक्रे, ऐहिष्ट, ईहिष्यते, ईहितुम्, ईहित) .²1 To wish, desire, long for; have in mind, think of with <ab>acc.</ab> or <ab>inf.</ab>; ईहन्ते … अर्थसंचयान् <ls>Bg. 16. 12</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">7. 22</ls>; <ls>Ms. 4. 15</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">3. 126</ls>; ऐहिष्ट तं कारयितुं कृतात्मा <ls>Bk. 1. 11</ls>. .²2 To endeavour to obtain. .²3 To aim at or attempt, endeavour, strive; माधुर्यं मधुबिन्दुना रचयितुं क्षाराम्बुधेरीहते <ls>Bh. 2. 6</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 116</ls>. .²4 To take care of. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To impel, urge.
